title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for persistent low back pain.

HPI
The patient is a 62-year-old male presenting today for evaluation of chronic low back pain. He reports a dull, aching sensation in the lumbar region that has persisted for three months. He describes the pain as worsening after prolonged sitting or lifting heavy objects. He denies any radiating pain down the legs, numbness, or tingling in the lower extremities. He has attempted over-the-counter ibuprofen with minimal relief.

Medication List
Ibuprofen 400mg as needed.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. He appears in no acute distress. Physical examination of the lumbar spine reveals mild tenderness to palpation over the L4-L5 region. Range of motion is slightly limited due to discomfort. Neurological exam of the lower extremities is intact, with normal strength, sensation, and reflexes.

Assessment
1. Chronic low back pain.

Plan
1. Start a course of physical therapy twice weekly to focus on core strengthening and lumbar mobility.
2. Continue ibuprofen as needed for pain management.
3. Follow up in four weeks to assess progress.

Problem List
1. COPD
explanations: COPD appears only in a problem list and is not addressed in this encounter, so it is not supported for this date of service.

distractors.why: A problem-list entry alone does not show the condition affected care at this visit.
